name: Les Heures Bleues : Mariage à Astérie
source:
The detective Aurore Dupin is tasked with finding the source of the weird noises heard at night in the old mountain village of Astérie!

While Astérie is preparing for Hélène Marvos wedding, Aurore quickly realizes that the mysteries of Astérie are more than simple nocturnal noises...

With the help of the manor's servants: Léda, Léticia, and Hender!

Meanwhile, discover the story of the Golden Knight and his faithful steed!

What is the real mystery behind this story?

[From [url=https://fullsaphir.itch.io/les-heures-bleues-asterie]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
偵探奧蘿爾．迪潘接到任務，要找出古老山村阿斯泰裡每到夜間就傳出的怪聲究竟來自哪裡！

村民們正在籌備埃萊娜．馬爾沃斯的婚禮，奧蘿爾卻很快意識到，阿斯泰裡的謎團遠不止深夜的怪聲這麼簡單……

莊園裡的僕人勒達、萊蒂西婭和亨德會來幫忙！

同一時間，還可以探尋黃金騎士與他忠實坐騎的故事！

這個故事的背後，真正的謎團究竟是什麼？
